maddeler.e:
انصرمت (form VII)
# اِنْصَرَمْتُ (inṣaramtu) /in.sˤa.ram.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْصَرَمَ (inṣarama)
# اِنْصَرَمْتَ (inṣaramta) /in.sˤa.ram.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْصَرَمَ (inṣarama)
# اِنْصَرَمْتِ (inṣaramti) /in.sˤa.ram.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْصَرَمَ (inṣarama)
# اِنْصَرَمَتْ (inṣaramat) /in.sˤa.ra.mat/: third-pe
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
